description: This PHP source file defines the ArrayLoader class within the Twig templating engine, responsible for loading templates from an array for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: ArrayLoader
classes.description: A class that implements the LoaderInterface to load Twig templates from an array, primarily used for unit testing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayLoader with an optional array of templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets or updates a template in the loader by name.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source code of a template by name as a Source object; throws LoaderError if not found.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template with the given name exists.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key string based on the template name and content; throws LoaderError if template not found.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Determines if a template is fresh (not modified since a given time); always returns true if template exists, throws LoaderError if not.
